stemMd: How many subsets of a 5-element set contain a particular specified element?
explanationMd: Once the specified element is included, each of the other four elements independently may be included or excluded. That gives $2^4=16$.

distractorRationale.b: Assumes every subset has size two.
distractorRationale.d: Counts subsets both with and without the specified element.
